findings.quote: The solids were filtered off and washed with DCM
findings.message: The DCM Add step records solvent addition but does not represent washing the filtered solids. Preserve the wash explicitly as an unmapped action because the permitted operations do not include a solids-wash operation.

findings.message: The generic chromatography method omits silica flash specificity. The solvent composition and gradient appear in evidence but are not operationally mapped; preserve them explicitly as unsupported operational details.
